name: Bounty at Shark Fin Port
source:
You're embarking on a dangerous quest, and you're going to need some help! You'll have to find some allies in the goblin town of Shark Fin Port -- and perhaps you'll find something even more special in the process...

[From [url=https://makothegoblin.itch.io/bounty-at-shark-fin-port]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你即将踏上一段危险的冒险旅程，需要找人帮忙！你得去鲨鱼鳍港的哥布林小镇寻找盟友——说不定途中还能找到更特别的东西……

[来源：[url=https://makothegoblin.itch.io/bounty-at-shark-fin-port]Itch.io[/url]]
